value.rationale: A complete exact all-Nash correspondence for a natural class of asymmetric public-good spillovers is qualitatively more informative than existence of specialized equilibria. Linear-arithmetic-time parameterization, exceptional hyperplanes, nontrivial even-cycle positivity cutoff, and opposing-small-shock selection distinguish a structural result from arbitrary finite computation. It is explicitly limited to one outgoing neighbor and unit spillovers.
